officialPoIntegration.title: G-SYS Official PO Integration
officialPoIntegration.subtitle: Independent of Demo Send - foundation for future real G-SYS Integration (Phase 7-C2A).
officialPoIntegration.officialPoNoUnassignedNote: The numbering rule is unresolved CUSTOMER REVIEW, so no number is auto-assigned this Phase. This is not an error.
officialPoIntegration.requestDialogBody:
Creates an Integration Request and checks consistency against Legacy Master data (Preflight).
This does NOT register anything in G-SYS or submit any File.
officialPoIntegration.errorNotApproved: Only an APPROVED order can prepare G-SYS Integration.
